audit_items.proof_trace: crypto.randomBytes(n) returns exactly n bytes and Buffer.toString('hex') encodes each byte as exactly 2 lowercase hex characters, guaranteeing len(output) == n*2 and output in /^[0-9a-f]+$/ for all positive integer n. All callers (route.ts L42-43, consent/actions.ts L77) pass fixed positive constants (32, 48), never caller-controlled or attacker-supplied values.
